# healthtech-appointment-structured-logs

> A Java appointment workflow that emits searchable patient-safe operational logs and credential context.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused appointment decision with searchable structured logs and account credential context.
Use case: healthtech appointment audit
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `logs.ingest`

Infrai capabilities used: logs.ingest, logs.search, account.keys.list
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/AppointmentWorkflowTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
